patches.title: Guard tiffcrop logging before output creation
patches.description: Avoids passing a null output handle to TIFFFileName when crop validation fails before output creation.

dep3.origin: Backport of upstream commit 4d28af5, adapted for the pinned distro source versions.

tests.baselineExpectation: On the valid one-pixel TIFF, impossible left/right margins fail crop validation before output creation. With an output debug dump enabled, failure cleanup dereferences the still-null output handle; Valgrind must report an invalid read in TIFFFileName.
tests.patchedExpectation: The crop error is reported, the debug dump records '(not opened)', and Valgrind reports zero errors.

patches.title: Bound tiffcrop's debug sample dump loop
patches.description: Bounds the debug output loop to the MAX_SAMPLES capacity of srcbuffs.

dep3.origin: Backport of upstream commit 88cf9db, adapted for Ubuntu Focal's tiffcrop source.

tests.baselineExpectation: On the exact nine-sample separate-planar RGB/extra fixture and level-2 debug command, the installed baseline must report its target-specific 8-byte uninitialised-value stack signature and a nonzero Memcheck summary (exit 97). The ordered three-frame signatures were captured from the exact installed baseline package for each configured target. This binary-specific runtime signal does not symbolize the stack-array boundary.
tests.patchedExpectation: The installed patched tiffcrop completes the same debug dump and tiffinfo can read the output.
